units.english: When there is no one left to speak for the trees, these cannons will do all the talking.
units.italian: When there is no one left to speak for the trees, these cannons will do all the talking.

units.english: This granule of exotic Windjammer pollen is not only replete with nutritious proteins, but also appears to contain valuable platinum group elements bound in organic molecules. This includes a collection of complex enzymes, which appear to be capable of catalyzing many difficult reactions with ease.
units.italian: This granule of exotic Windjammer pollen is not only replete with nutritious proteins, but also appears to contain valuable platinum group elements bound in organic molecules. This includes a collection of complex enzymes, which appear to be capable of catalyzing many difficult reactions with ease.

units.english: Closer to a berry than a fruit, this tart prize of a Windjammer tree is not only delicious, but is rich in nutrients. It can be refined to extract a variety of useful medicinal compounds, giving it value both as a delicacy and as a remedy.
units.italian: Closer to a berry than a fruit, this tart prize of a Windjammer tree is not only delicious, but is rich in nutrients. It can be refined to extract a variety of useful medicinal compounds, giving it value both as a delicacy and as a remedy.

units.english: This allergenic menace is dreaded by captains across the galaxy. Only the most powerful civilizations could hope to contend with even a single granule.
units.italian: Questa minaccia allergizzante è temuta dai capitani di tutta la galassia. Solo le civiltà più potenti potrebbero sperare di affrontare anche un singolo granello.

units.english: Marginally tamer than a free floating pollen granule, this sprouting terror is still not to be underestimated.
units.italian: Appena più docile di un granello di polline libero nello spazio, questo germoglio terrorizzante non va comunque sottovalutato.
